title: Marine Cargo, Hull, and Aviation Insurance

Marine Cargo, Hull, and Aviation Insurance

Whether you're transporting goods across oceans, operating vessels, or managing aircraft, your business faces unique risks—from weather disruptions to mechanical failures and accidents.

Marine Hull, Cargo, and Aviation Insurance provide comprehensive protection for your assets in motion. Marine Hull Insurance is insurance protection against loss of or damage to a ship. Marine Cargo Insurance is coverage against loss of or damage to in-transit cargo over waterways, land, and air. Aviation Insurance is insurance coverage for aircraft and for the damage, injury, or loss of life.

At TRINITY, we offer a comprehensive Marine Hull, Cargo, and Aviation Insurance that provides financial support. The following is the coverage for Marine Hull Insurance:
• Losses due to the total loss of the vessel or expenses due to repair or damages to the vessel's hull, machinery, or equipment
• Losses due to the vessel being missing
• Vessel's share in losses, expenses, and contribution allowed in general average
• Necessary and properly incurred expenses for the salvage of the vessel

What is the information needed for Marine Hull, Cargo, and Aviation Insurance?
• Assured's Name
• Voyage route
• Frequency of voyage
• Type of cover to be applied - cargo, hull, or aviation
• Details of vessel/aircraft
• Conveyance - land (truck), sea (ship), air (plane)
• Geographical limit
• Sum insured
• Mortgage, if applicable
• Loss history
• Broker of Record (BOR) - form will be provided by Trinity
• KYC form – form will be provided by Trinity
